verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs list built-in search and download via Hugging Face. Its CLI offers `lms get` to fetch models and `lms load` to run them. A hands-on user confirms you can search a model on Hugging Face and it 'downloads and just works'. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Hugging Face integration (which model formats and repos are supported), an explanation of why some Hugging Face models are not listed, and clearer discoverability of the download flow, which community users found unclear.
